paragraphs.text: Eln Forest was a forest in northwestern Terisiare during the Dark Age of Dominaria .

It was located near the edge of the Colekgan Mountains , across a wide flat plain from the Urhaalan Valley . Eln Forest was populated by Ironroot treefolk , and a tribe of elves that came into conflict with the Urhaalan minotaurs through the schemes of the sorceress Sacumon .
The hermit Istvan became an axe murderer living in Eln Forest during the Dark Age . At the onset of the Ice Age , Eln Forest was slowly covered and destroyed by the widening Great Glacier .
